story.title: Thoughtful care starts with listening.

points: A plan for access and pets

guide.title: The details, room by room.
guide.intro: An explicit checklist makes it easier to choose the right service and know what to expect.

notes.title: In the kitchen
notes.text: Countertops, accessible appliance exteriors, sinks, and floors form the regular reset. Inside ovens, refrigerators, or cabinets should be discussed as separate tasks.

notes.title: In the bathroom
notes.text: Include sinks, mirrors, toilets, showers, and floors in the agreed scope. Note delicate finishes and product restrictions before work begins.

notes.title: In living spaces
notes.text: Accessible dusting, vacuuming, and suitable floor care help reset the rooms you use every day. Moving heavy furniture or handling valuables should not be assumed.

notes.title: Before the visit
notes.text: Clear loose clutter, secure pets, and identify fragile items. Share product sensitivities and access arrangements so the visit can focus on the cleaning.

faq.q: Do I need to be home?
faq.a: Either arrangement can work when access is agreed in advance. This preview offers an at-home handoff or a coordinated entry arrangement.

faq.q: Can I choose just a few rooms?
faq.a: Yes. The planner lets you identify rooms and priorities. A real quote would account for size, condition, scope, and available time.

faq.q: Are all products suitable for every surface?
faq.a: No. Share finish care instructions, sensitivities, and product restrictions with the provider. Delicate materials need suitable methods.
